meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 装上后,当用户问起 senpi 提示(Tip: 行)的含义时,Claude 会先运行 `senpi --list-tips` 获取真实提示列表,并检查该用户的设置确认实际可见的提示,然后阅读相关功能代码,给出深度解释并引用文件路径。
howto.when: 当用户提到 “Tip:” 行、说 give-me-tips,或询问提示的含义/用法等时触发。

say.text: give-me-tips,启动提示里说的重试失败那条,具体怎么判断的?
say.note: 会先查提示列表再验证代码。

say.text: 我能看到哪些提示?为什么有些提示不显示?
say.note: Claude 会读设置并说明个人可见范围。

howto.what_en: After installation, when the user asks about a senpi tip (Tip: line), Claude runs `senpi --list-tips` to get the live tip list, checks the user's settings to see which tips are actually visible, then reads the feature code and explains in depth with file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions a "Tip:" line, says give-me-tips, or asks what a tip means / how it works / which tips are visible.

say_en.text: Explain that 'Fable 5 refused' Tip: line - what mechanism is behind it?
say_en.note: Claude reads the code and explains refusal detection.

say_en.text: give-me-tips, how does the retry-failure startup tip decide what to do?
say_en.note: It lists tips first, then verifies the code.

say_en.text: Which tips can I see and why are some missing?
say_en.note: Claude checks settings and explains your visible set.
